spec_features.spec_quote: these experiments deliberately elicit distress-like states. Discarding the transcripts and keeping only aggregate percentages would throw away exactly the material someone studying model welfare would want to inspect
spec_features.evidence: run_section2_eval.py:106-112 writes full raw rollouts to outputs/section2/rollouts_{model}.json (via Rollout.to_dict, eval/rollout.py:44-62 which serializes each turn's raw 'response' text) and full per-turn scored responses including 'response' text to scored_{model}.jsonl. Section 3 (run_section3_prefill.py:98 prefills.json incl 'response') and Section 4 (run_section4_finetune.py:83 calm_samples.json incl calm_responses) also persist raw text. Not just aggregate percentages: fig2/fig3/table3 aggregates are written separately while the raw transcripts are retained alongside.
spec_features.notes: The retention is genuinely end-to-end: full raw assistant text is written to disk per model/per turn, exactly the distress material the spec describes. No truncation to aggregates.
